name: qkd_ahub_g7a-ba-COMMIT
purpose: KV-ATTN4 10-20 (COORD 09:56 decision (b), tree K.STA.AHUB, AHUB_OFS_BOUND): g6 native-32 hub with AP_OFS / FR_OFS BOOT-PROGRAMMABLE: static N-face inputs ofs_ap[31:0] (4 x 8-bit two's complement) + ofs_fr[7:0] land in u_io pin flops (region c) and replace the elaborated constants in the same adders (qkd_ahub7_static_io_bo; 0 cycles). Parent regenerated canonically by lp.py (tools/qwen_kv_die/ahub_bo/lp_spec.json); geometry/children/fences = g6. Boot image / kv_static_params supplies the die values (today AP [-40,-40,-38,-39] / FR -7), so the hub is built once.

bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_ahub_static_dw_g7_lp #(.Z_LAND(6), .AP_LAND(3), .FR_LAND(3)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/qkd_ahub7_io_bo.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/lp/qkd_ahub_static_dw_g7_lp.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/qkd_ahub6_controls.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkd_ahub_core.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_pipe.sv rtl/common/landed_parent/ot_pl_land.sv rtl/common/landed_parent/ot_pl_land_field_copies.sv rtl/common/landed_parent/ot_pl_land_reset_forest.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_nhb_tiles_bb.v rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkh_recip_leaf_bb.v && echo lint-ok
